estilo: Painted fantasy RPG item illustration, matching a hand-painted tabletop card: realistic digital oil painting with fine, visible brushwork and rich material rendering (thick hand-blown glass with small imperfections and bubbles, cork, dripping sealing wax, twine, aged brass, leather). Exactly ONE object, shown in three-quarter view from slightly above (about 30 degrees), tilted a little on a diagonal, centered in a square frame and filling about 70% of it, with even empty margins on all four sides; no part of the object touches or is cut by the image edges. Lighting: warm, soft key light from the upper left, a subtle cool rim light on the right edge, gentle specular highlights on the glass; the liquid may glow softly from within, but every effect (glow, smoke, mist, sparks) stays inside the vessel or touching it: no aura, halo, light bloom or rays around the object. Palette: warm earthy neutrals (umber, sepia, ochre, cork brown, aged brass) with a single saturated accent color that comes from the vessel's contents. Vessel families, keep them consistent across the series: a drinkable POTION is a round-bottomed glass flask with a long neck, cork stopper sealed with red-brown wax and wrapped with twine; an OIL is a small squat flat-sided glass vial with a wide cork and a thick drip of the liquid running down its side; a GRENADE is a throwable spherical glass orb held in a few thin hammered-iron bands, with a short wax-sealed spout capped by a small solid iron knob. Background: perfectly flat, uniform, pure white (#FFFFFF) from edge to edge, with no texture, gradient, vignette, surface, horizon or reflection. The object floats on the white: no cast shadow and no contact shadow on the background.
evitar: text, letters, words, numbers, runes, glyphs that look like writing, labels or tags with writing, logos, watermark, signature; frame, border, card layout, UI, parchment texture; hands, people, faces, skulls, creatures; scenery, table, cloth, shelf, any surface or horizon; colored, gradient or textured background, vignette, cast shadow, drop shadow, reflection on the ground; more than one vessel, duplicates, extra props, coins; hanging loops, open rings or handles with background showing through them; glow halo, aura, light bloom or rays around the object, sparks or smoke floating detached from the vessel; object cropped or touching the image edges; photographic studio product shot, glossy 3D render or plastic look, cartoon, flat vector, anime, neon colors
